# 8 · Compute & USB Installation

## At a glance

| | |
|---|---|
| **You'll do** | Mount the Thor; route + land USB peripherals; power the compute from the logic bus |
| **Prerequisites** | [Electronics Bay](electronics-bay.md), [Power Bay](power-bay.md) |

!!! note "Stub — assembly steps coming"
    Mount the **Thor AGX** compute and route/land the USB devices (lidars, StampPLC, Tab5). USB
    layout matters — see the hard-won hub/port lessons in [Thor setup](../thor-setup.md).

!!! warning "USB layout is not an afterthought"
    Put peripherals on **root / USB-A host ports (or USB-C 5b)** — not on an overloaded
    bus-powered hub, which browns out and drops devices. See [Thor setup](../thor-setup.md).
